title: NSTAR Electric Company files a project change filing related to proposed modifications to the design of the 345-kV transmission line, proposed changes to the height and location of other ancillary structures in the area of Plymouth Municipal Airport and the towns of Carver, Plymouth, Bourne and Barnstable
filings: Counsel for Attorney General files Withdrawal of Patrick Tarmey as counsel
Siting Division Director advises NSTAR to comply with FAA requirements and concludes that no further inquiry by the EFSB is necessary regarding the project change
Counsel for NSTAR files requested additional information relating to structures from Carver Substation and requests EFSB to approve additional changes
Kerry LaLiberte files comments on project change
Presiding Officer requests additional information from NSTAR relating to structures from Carver Substation to the State Forest Transition Station
Siting Division Director advises NSTAR that further review of the project change relating to the State Forest to Plymouth Station line segment is not necessary
Counsel for NSTAR files FAA’s determination of no hazard for structures 13A, 17A and 18A

Counsel for NSTAR files requested information relative to pole heights, visual impacts, location of structures, notification to residents, original design violations and alternatives NSTAR has considered to raising pole heights
Presiding Officer requests additional information from NSTAR with regard to the proposed project change
Counsel for NSTAR forwards comments regarding the review process of its current project change
Presiding officer forwards letter to counsel for NSTAR regarding proposed project change
Counsel for NSTAR forwards expected construction start dates for the proposed project changes
Counsel for NSTAR files FAA’s determination of no hazard for structures 11-19, and a copy of NSTAR’s application to FAA for structures: 13A, 17A and 18A
Counsel for NSTAR files an updated redesign of structures 11 through 19 in the form of a Project Change Supplement
Counsel for NSTAR files completed MOA to be inserted as Att. 4, Section 6 of Project Change Filing

NSTAR Electric Company files a project change filing related to proposed modifications to the design of the 345-kV transmission line, proposed changes to the height and location of other ancillary structures in the area of Plymouth Municipal Airport and the towns of Carver, Plymouth, Bourne and Barnstable
